t: What he said at each end of the day
a: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
p: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsaynā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūt wa ilayka-n-nushūr
m: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the rising.
